cmd.fn: async () => { const w = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) { const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x => x.offsetParent && /figure it out/i.test(x.textContent)); if (b) b.click(); const mg = window.MinigameFramework; if (mg && mg.currentMinigame) { try { mg.endMinigame(false); } catch (e) {} } await w(250); } return 1; }

async () => { const R = "server_room"; const w = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); if (!window.rooms[R]) await window.loadRoom(R); const r = window.rooms[R]; const L = window.lightingSystem; const sc = L.scene; const cam = sc.cameras.main; cam.stopFollow(); cam.centerOn(r.position.x + r.map.widthInPixels / 2, r.position.y + r.map.heightInPixels / 2); L.switchOff(R); await w(600); const snap = () => new Promise(res => sc.game.renderer.snapshot(img => { const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = 480; c.height = 480; const x = c.getContext('2d'); x.drawImage(img, (img.width - 640) / 2, (img.height - 640) / 2, 640, 640, 0, 0, 480, 480); res(c.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.85)); })); const frames = []; const t0 = performance.now(); L.switchOn(R); for (const t of [0, 100, 180, 260, 340, 450, 560, 700, 900, 1200]) { while (performance.now() - t0 < t) await w(5); frames.push([Math.round(performance.now() - t0), await snap()]); } return JSON.stringify(frames); }
